mapper.sql: dataset_id,dataset_name,description, status_id,size_formatted, file_count,user_id, downloadCount,created_time,updated_time, base_address,true_address, version,is_deleted
mapper.select:
select dataset.dataset_id, dataset.dataset_name, dataset.description, status.`status`, dataset.size_formatted, dataset.file_count, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name) AS task_names, user.name, dataset.downloadCount, dataset.created_time, dataset.updated_time, dataset.true_address, dataset.base_address from dataset left join user on dataset.user_id = user.user_id left join status on dataset.status_id = status.status_id left join dataset_task dt on dt.dataset_id = dataset.dataset_id left join task t on t.id = dt.task_id where dataset.is_deleted = 0
and dataset.dataset_name like concat('%',#{datasetListVo.search},'%')
and exists (select 1 from dataset_task dt2 where dt2.dataset_id = dataset.dataset_id and dt2.task_id = #{datasetListVo.taskId})
group by dataset.dataset_id

select dataset.dataset_id, dataset.dataset_name, dataset.description, status.`status`, dataset.size_formatted, dataset.file_count, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name) AS taskNames, user.name, dataset.downloadCount, dataset.created_time, dataset.updated_time, dataset.base_address, dataset.true_address from dataset left join user on dataset.user_id = user.user_id left join status on dataset.status_id = status.status_id left join dataset_task dt on dt.dataset_id = dataset.dataset_id left join task t on t.id = dt.task_id where dataset.is_deleted = 0 and dataset.dataset_id = #{datasetId} group by dataset.dataset_id
